This fixture reproduces a neutral citation split across a PDF page break,
with the page-number footer landing between the reporter token ("ND") and
the opinion number. The text is synthetic — modeled on a real page-break
splice but containing no case-identifying details — and reproduces the
"2024 ND 9" phantom-cite bug.

9
